title: nowPlaying signal
description: Current track from Apple Music or Spotify (AppleScript to an already-running player). GET /api/signals/now-playing, polled every 2 s by the runtime, which adds `artwork` and `recv` before forwarding to plugins. 404 when providers.now_playing.enabled is false. Artwork comes from the player; the iTunes Search fallback (providers.now_playing.itunes_artwork_fallback) is off by default. SENSITIVE (listening habits). If the poll fails the runtime forwards just {state: 'stopped', recv, artwork: null}.

source.description: Player the track comes from; '' before anything played, 'demo' in the runtime's ?demo mode.

key.description: Opaque id (12 hex chars) that changes whenever the track changes; '' when nothing played yet.

duration.description: Track length in seconds (0 when unknown).

hasArt.description: True when /api/signals/artwork has an image for this key.

ts.description: When the server last read the player. Unix time in seconds (float). 0 before the first read.

artwork.description: Added by the runtime: artwork as a data:image/jpeg;base64 URL (max 600 px), or null when there is none or the player is stopped. Absent in the raw HTTP response.

recv.description: Added by the runtime: when it received this poll, Unix time in MILLISECONDS. Absent in the raw HTTP response.
